newsitem.title: SPAIN: ETA prisoner found hanged in Spanish jail cell.
newsitem.headline: ETA prisoner found hanged in Spanish jail cell.

text.p: The body of an ETA Basque separatist rebel prisoner was found hanged in his jail cell late on Sunday, prison officials said in a statement.

Prison warders in a jail in central Spain found Juan Carlos Hernando, 35, who was serving a six year sentence for collaboration with an armed band, hanged with his hands loosely bound in front of him.
Hernando was found dead at 23.40 p.m. (2140 GMT) on Sunday. He was alone in his cell.
The Albacete prison doctor tried to revive him without success, the statement said.
Prison officials said they were opening an investigation into Hernando's death as was usual in "an event of these circumstances".

ETA, which has killed some 800 people in a nearly 30-year campaign for Basque independence, murdered a young politician last week in a killing that sparked national outrage. Several ETA inmates have since condemned the attack.
